title: Deep Water
intro: Some rallies don't end, and your legs are full when the next point starts. This is that feeling on purpose. Six efforts of forty seconds with eighty seconds between, which isn't enough rest, and that's the idea. Go hard, RPE 9. Each forty seconds is skater step-outs, split squats and a bear crawl, and nothing jumps.

You need a clear strip four metres by two, a floor you won't slip on, shoes, and a timer that beeps. Fitted carpet is fine, a loose rug isn't. Padel rallies run longer, so padel players do fifty seconds: twenty, twenty and ten. Wrists aching? March on the spot instead of crawling.

before.label: Not today
before.text: A sore ankle, knee, calf, hamstring, groin or Achilles, or an injury in the last month? Get it looked at first.

before.label: Stop and get it checked
before.text: A sharp pain, pain that spreads, numbness, swelling, a joint that gives way, or a sudden pull or pop.

before.label: Stop now
before.text: Chest pain, dizziness, a heartbeat that races or skips, or breathing that doesn't feel right. Get it looked at before you train again. Told to be careful with hard exercise? Check with your doctor first.

before.label: A day or two later
before.text: Far more sore than normal, or your pee goes dark? Get it checked the same day.

before.label: Keep clear
before.text: 48 hours clear of a match and heavy lower-body lifting. Leave it out of a tournament week.

before.label: First time
before.text: Do four rounds and stop there. It still counts. If your knees cave or your steps get sloppy, that was your last round.

good: Stay light on the balls of your feet with your arms swinging
Feel your legs warming up and your breathing lifting
Hold a wall and swing the leg front to back, then side to side
The swing should get a little bigger every rep
bad: Arching your lower back to throw the leg higher

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor with Overhead Reach

good: Squeeze the back glute, then reach the same-side arm overhead
Feel it at the front of the back hip
bad: Arching your lower back to feel more

good: Step long, drop the back hip, then reach the inside arm up to the ceiling
Feel the front of the back hip and your upper back open up
bad: Rushing the reach before the hips have dropped

good: Push the floor away through your heels
Squeeze the glutes hard at the top
bad: Arching your lower back to lift higher

good: Step wide and sit back into that hip, chest tall
Feel the inside of the straight leg stretch
bad: Letting the bent knee cave inward

good: Step wide to one side and reach the other foot behind you, at half speed
Feel the outside of the stepping hip doing the work
bad: Hopping off the floor instead of stepping

good: Step wide to one side and reach the other foot behind you
Feel the outside of the stepping hip doing the work
bad: Hopping off the floor instead of stepping

good: Drop straight down between your feet and push back up
Feel the front thigh and glute doing the work
bad: Letting the front knee cave inward

items.name: Bear Crawl
items.detail: 10 sec, crawl forward and walk back

good: Keep your knees just off the floor and step hand and foot together
Feel your trunk holding you still while the arms and legs move
bad: Letting your hips rise or swing side to side

good: Walk slowly and shake out your arms and legs
Your heart rate should drop a little with every step
bad: Sitting straight down while your heart is still pounding

good: Rest one hand on your belly, breathe in through your nose for four and out through your mouth for eight
Feel only the hand on your belly move
bad: Rushing the exhale to get to the next breath
